translations.web: The Lord Yahweh says to these bones: “Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and you will live.
translations.bsb: This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: I will cause breath to enter you, and you will come to life.
translations.kjv: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
translations.asv: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah unto these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.
